scope: One debug and two exact-harness route-free replays of official MCP SDK 2.3.1 client-generated same-process rate-window reset against a checksum-verified unsigned experimental Debian 12 amd64 package built from trusted main 6730484. Each installed run used a fresh package in a disposable 128 MiB, 64 PID container with a 64-FD server soft limit.
tested_package_manifest: SHA256SUMS from exact-main CI run 42177227874; all three files verified before testing
reproduce: Install pinned SDK with npm ci --prefix tools/mcp-sdk-probe --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund; set OUTBOUND_GUARD_TEST_SDK_DIR to that directory, OUTBOUND_GUARD_TEST_SDK_PACKAGE to the verified .deb, OUTBOUND_GUARD_TEST_SDK_PACKAGE_SHA256 to its digest, then run bash tools/netns_adversarial_probe.sh target/debug/outbound-guard-mcp twice.
checks: Before the wait, 60/61 per-host allowed-HTTP and failed-DNS calls yielded EGRESS_RATE_LIMIT on the 61st calls without DNS/HTTP. The parent waited until 61 seconds after the failed-DNS fill completed, keeping the same server process alive. The official SDK then obtained EGRESS_ALLOWED and one /plain HTTP hit for allowed.test, plus EGRESS_DNS_FAILURE after one A and one AAAA query for budget-failure.test with no HTTP. The bounded audit resource stayed at 256 events, ended with those two rules, and tools/list remained responsive. Fresh package install/hash/version, removal/residue and namespace/container cleanup passed.
local_verification: One debug and two installed-package route-free suites each passed 2671 decisions; 47 Rust tests, 19 Python tests, cargo build --locked --bins --examples, cargo fmt/clippy, JS/Python syntax and git diff checks passed.
sampling: In-container /proc server FD monitor requested 5 ms samples before the one-minute wait; its maximum is a lower bound on transient peaks. VmHWM, container memory/PID high-water were collected before the wait, while process liveness, DNS/HTTP and audit controls were tested afterward.
limitations: One modern SDK client, one experimental Debian package/OS/architecture, two finite package repeats and a 61-second wait. Does not establish exact expiry edge behavior, the process-hour reset, cross-process budgets, arbitrary concurrency or sustained resource bounds, other native clients, traffic through other tools, exact official candidate, owner residual-risk acceptance or independent human review. Four AI Scraping Defense repositories still require separate adversarial evidence.
